Genesis3D C89 arena/fixed protocol patch

Build/test status
- make all with -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2: OK
- ./selftest: OK actor_bytes=1129 body_bytes=534 motion_bytes=150/152 motions=2 vertices=3
- bash smoke.sh: OK
- generated _smoke artifact checksum set: byte-for-byte equal to the uploaded baseline run

Protocol audit
- Source token audit over *.c/*.h: OK for dynamic-allocation call names, FP scalar type names, and standard input object name.
- Additional source audit: no scanf-family decimal input, no C99 integer/bool headers, no 64-bit long integer extension.

Architecture changes
- KIB wavelet scratch now comes from g3d_arena.
- GeBm mip decode/unpack has arena-aware entry points.
- Body material RGBA decode has an arena-aware entry point.
- ASCII MOT decimal parse/write now uses integer/fixed-point helpers.
- Indexed delta accumulation now uses integer saturation.
- CLI and regression tests call the arena-aware texture/KIB paths.

Compatibility check
- The smoke outputs produced by this patch match the uploaded baseline's smoke outputs exactly by SHA-256 file list comparison.
